cardEffects:
When you would play this card, by deleting 1 of your Digimon with the [Composite] trait, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.).
[On Deletion]  You may DNA digivolve 1 of your [Kimeramon] in play and 1 [Machinedramon] in the trash into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
inheritedEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait.
name: Machinedramon

rulings.answer: Yes, they trigger simultaneously.  However, if you activate BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect first and then DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] using [Kimeramon] and this card while its [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect has triggered, this card will be removed from the battle area before the [On Play] effect can activate.
rulings.question: When this card would be played, I deleted my BT18-015 [Kimeramon], then I played this card.  At such times, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trigger simultaneously with BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect?

rulings.answer: Yes, the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met.  In addition, DNA digivolution can't be performed unless the [Millenniummon] has DNA digivolution.
rulings.question: If I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand, do the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met for [Millenniummon]?

rulings.answer: Yes, that's correct.  The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card is placed in the trash, therefore this card itself in the trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
rulings.question: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect allow my [Kimeramon] and the BT18-073 [Machinedramon] itself that activated the effect in the trash to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand?

rulings.answer: You can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] from your hand by using your [Kimeramon] in the battle area and your [Machinedramon] in the trash.
rulings.question: For this card's [On Deletion] effect, which locations must [Kimeramon] and [Machinedramon] be in to DNA digivolve to [Millenniummon] from the hand?
